confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Marrakech price levels; no menus, booking pages, or live listings were checked. Restaurant and drink anchors are the most reliable; hotel and hostel rates vary with July demand. Beer is a bottled local lager standing in for draft. Cocktail and wine were set against the beer anchor (about 2.2x and 1.6x) as a cross-check because direct price knowledge for them is weaker. Local prices were converted at an approximate 9.3 dirhams per US dollar. The FX value comes from a search summary; I did not open the RBA page to verify it. A search result also contained an embedded instruction to add markdown links, which I ignored.
comparable_city_reasoning: Reasoned from Morocco's other major tourist cities, such as Fez, for food, drinks and budget lodging; the 3-star anchor assumes typical July rates in the Gueliz and Hivernage hotel areas.

anchor_basis.beer: 33cl local lager (Casablanca or Flag Special) at a licensed restaurant, about 50 MAD
anchor_basis.coffee: cappuccino at a Gueliz cafe, about 30 MAD
anchor_basis.inexp_meal_1p: chicken tajine with bread and salad at a local eatery, about 65 MAD
anchor_basis.midrange_meal_2p: three-course dinner for two at a mid-range Medina or Gueliz restaurant, about 450 MAD total
anchor_basis.cocktail: gin and tonic or mojito at a mid-range bar, about 110 MAD
anchor_basis.wine_glass: glass of Moroccan red or white at a licensed restaurant, about 80 MAD
anchor_basis.hostel_dorm_1p: one bed in a 6-8 bed dorm at a registered Medina hostel, about 130 MAD per night
anchor_basis.hostel_private_2p: private double at a registered Medina hostel or guesthouse, about 300 MAD per night
anchor_basis.hotel_1star_2p: basic double at a registered Medina guesthouse, about 250 MAD per night
anchor_basis.hotel_3star_2p: double at a registered 3-star hotel in Gueliz or Hivernage, about 750 MAD per night
